statement: The US Navy or Department of Defense publicly confirms a direct armed engagement between US forces and Iranian forces or Iranian-operated vessels or aircraft in or near the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if an official US Navy, CENTCOM, or DoD statement carried by two or more major outlets confirms such an engagement occurring between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.

statement: A named international monitor, the Gaza Board of Peace, or the US government publicly confirms that Hamas has physically handed over heavy weapons between 2026-08-07 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if an official statement from the Board of Peace, a named international monitoring body, or the US government confirms a completed heavy-weapons handover in that window. Announcements of agreement alone do not resolve true.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee announces an increase in the federal funds target range at a scheduled meeting held between 2026-08-07 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if an FOMC statement issued between 2026-08-07 and 2026-12-31 announces a higher target range for the federal funds rate.

statement: Front-month WTI crude futures settle above 95.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if NYMEX front-month WTI settlement exceeds 95.00 dollars on any session from 2026-08-07 through 2026-09-30, per exchange or major financial press data.

statement: Frontex or the European Commission publicly announces a deployment of personnel or emergency border funding to Spain in response to the Ceuta crossings between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if Frontex or the European Commission issues a public statement in that window announcing personnel deployment or emergency funds to Spain for the Ceuta border.

statement: A US congressional committee, member of Congress, or federal agency publicly issues a letter, inquiry, or hearing notice addressed to Anthropic regarding the reported autonomous breach of three organizations between 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if such a letter, formal inquiry, or hearing notice naming Anthropic and referencing the incident is publicly reported between 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-30.

statement: CISA adds the JetBrains TeamCity remote code execution vulnerability disclosed in late July 2026 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-07 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog shows an entry for that TeamCity vulnerability with a date added between 2026-08-07 and 2026-10-30.

statement: The CBOE Volatility Index closes above 35.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-08-07 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the official VIX close exceeds 35.00 on any session from 2026-08-07 through 2026-10-30, per CBOE or major financial press data.

statement: The confirmed death toll from the Broad Peak avalanche in Pakistan reaches eight or more, per public reporting between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: True if Pakistani authorities, Alpine Club of Pakistan, or major wire reporting state a confirmed death toll of at least eight from that avalanche during the window.

statement: The mayor of St Paul, Minnesota resigns, is removed from office, or announces she will not seek re-election between 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if credible reporting between 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-30 confirms resignation, removal, or a public announcement of not seeking re-election.
